provider: Cloud.ru Evolution Object Storage (ex-SberCloud) — cheapest Russian object rate, VAT-inclusive

free_tier.stated: Single-zone S3 object storage ₽1.1346 per GB per month including 22 % VAT (₽0.93 ex-VAT). Tariff document takes effect 2026-09-28. No volume published.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: No retention clause documented in available terms.

egress.terms: Tariff documentation lists a small initial free monthly allowance ('первые не тарифицируются'), with subsequent transfer metered. Egress terms remain unverified.

tooling: S3-compatible; endpoint class obs.ru-moscow-1.hc.sbercloud.ru answered 403 to an anonymous list (expected for a private bucket API). rclone `s3`, aws-cli.
chaining: Per-GB, so 5 TB and 20 TB share the rate.
limits_note: The ₽1.1346/GB rate is only for the single-zone class; multi-zone and the cold classes are separately priced and were not captured. Enterprise onboarding (legal entity or individual with Russian card).
reliability_note: Cloud.ru is the rebranded SberCloud and is the largest non-hyperscaler Russian cloud; the technical reliability is not in question. The commercial blocker is that tariff documents are PDFs behind a Russian-language portal, prices are VAT-inclusive for Russian entities, and the egress annex could not be read. So the total cost of ownership is unknown even though the storage line is the cheapest Russian object rate found.

extras.agent_focus: Wave 7 cheap-PAID lane, regional angle: storage sold in RUB / CNY / BRL / INR / ZAR / TRY / PLN / UAH that never appears on Western price lists. Every paid candidate carries price_per_tb_month at USD-converted list price. FX fixed 2026-10-21 from open.er-api.com: RUB 82.5719/USD, CNY 6.6913, BRL 5.0231, INR 94.9952, ZAR 16.3972, TRY 49.5978, PLN 3.8923, UAH 45.0922, EUR 0.89075/USD. Excluded per brief: AWS, Azure, GCP, Alibaba Cloud, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, IDrive e2. Headline result: the true regional floor with genuinely free egress is ~$2.00/TB/mo (Yandex 360 Profi 3 TB on a Russian card) rising to ~$4.17/TB/mo for the same product bought with a foreign card, and ~$5.95-7.56/TB/mo for flat-rate Western-facing file storage (TheHost, Rollin Host). Everything advertised below ~$2/TB/mo in this set is either capacity-capped, egress-metered, or unverifiable marketing.
